forecast_record.write_rule: append-only canonical JSON UTF8, immutable object/version and hash chain; no overwriting forecasts
forecast_record.hash_rule: sha256(canonical sorted-key JSON of every field except record_sha256); previous_record_sha256 links immutable prior record
forecast_record.missing_rule: suppress forecast with explicit UNQUALIFIED_INPUT / DATA_UNAVAILABLE, never substitute future observations

label_record.maturity_rule: resolve only after all horizon bars published, including when barrier hit earlier
label_record.write_rule: separate append-only label record referencing immutable forecast; original forecast unchanged
label_record.correction_rule: append superseding label with reason, preserve prior label; no retroactive forecast editing

prospective_plan.start: next exchange session after PR publication, only after separately authorised actual logging setup
prospective_plan.power: blinded planning using historical date-block variance for 1% relative Brier improvement; extend duration if insufficient
prospective_plan.multiple_testing: retain original 33-way Holm family; secondary pure-market addendum family remains separate
prospective_plan.deployment_gate: requires actual PIT vintage/publication evidence and independent predictive benefit; economic utility separate later gate
